hero_title: Ideas with character. Design with purpose.
hero_description: Brand identities, sharp visual campaigns and expressive illustration. Built with curiosity, clarity and a little mischief.
about_text: I'm Eki, a visual designer and illustrator based in Medan. Since 2014 I've worked across branding, illustration and campaign design for independent brands and teams including Grab. I like making identities with personality, then carrying the idea into every detail.
